note: session.files.media.v1 wire examples. The app must see session.files.media.v1 in the projects.list capabilities route before sending session.files.media or session.files.media.get. A path the parser accepts may still be answered invalid_path by the host (denied name, symlink, outside the session folder). Result paths are always relative. text/html results (session.files.artifact.v1, .html and .htm files) are capped at 5 MiB.
